Our party must put human rights first.

Thank you to Ray and Cathy Flynn for the nice afternoon and conversation at their home in South Boston. Ray Flynn is the former Ambassador to the Vatican and mayor of Boston. I have long admired Ray’s lifelong commitment to service for our country.

The AG has not prosecuted anyone in the Epstein class.

The AG has given Trump & his family indefinite immunity.

The AG has set up a slush fund to pay off Trump's criminal allies.

Enough is enough.

When Democrats are in charge, we will stand up against two tiers of justice.

We need to tax agentic AI more than workers.

Our tax code provides bonus depreciation for AI but is stacked against human ingenuity.

It makes no sense to provide tax breaks for capital in a capital biased world.

Thank you for speaking out on this @JonathanTurley. We should all read Lincoln's 1858 July 4th speech and Douglass's 1869 Composite Nation.


Jonathan Turley (@JonathanTurley)

He lost because he had the guts to stand up to the Epstein class and against the war.

Tonight, I say to this voters who feel rejected by Trump. We welcome you. Join our coalition to take on a rotten system and stand for the working class over the Epstein class. 

We will build a movement to stand for Team America.
